stories.title: Eos Energy CEO sells $980,000 in company stock
stories.summary: Eos Energy CEO Joe Mastrangelo sold $980,000 worth of company stock, according to a regulatory filing reported by Investing.com. The filing does not disclose the reason for the sale.
stories.whyItMatters: Insider sales at energy-storage firms can signal executive views on near-term valuation, so holders watch the filing trend.
whatToWatch: Any follow-up filings showing further insider sales or purchases at Eos Energy.
questions: Was this a scheduled sale under a pre-set trading plan, or a discretionary sale?

stories.title: Rocket Companies CEO Bray sells $2.95M in RKT stock
stories.summary: Rocket Companies President and CEO sold $2.95 million worth of RKT shares, per a filing reported by Investing.com. No reason for the sale was given in the report.

whatToWatch: Whether other Rocket Companies executives file similar sales in coming weeks.
questions: Does this sale fall under a pre-arranged 10b5-1 trading plan?

stories.title: Iridex CFO buys $4,977 in company stock
stories.summary: Iridex CFO Romeo Dizon bought $4,977 worth of company stock, according to a filing reported by Investing.com. The purchase is small relative to typical executive transactions.
stories.whyItMatters: Insider buying, even in small amounts, can signal management confidence in the company's outlook.
whatToWatch: Whether other Iridex insiders make similar purchases.
questions: Is this a one-off purchase or part of a regular buying pattern by the CFO?

stories.title: German American Bancorp directors buy shares
stories.summary: Two German American Bancorp directors bought company shares, per filings reported by Investing.com. Director Bawel bought $19,999 in shares, and director Andrew Seger bought $7,500 in shares.
stories.whyItMatters: Multiple directors buying shares around the same time can signal board-level confidence in the bank's outlook.
whatToWatch: Whether more German American Bancorp insiders file purchases in the near term.
questions: Were these purchases coordinated, or separate individual decisions?
